segments.thag7.5:1.3: Tena me sarabhaṅgoti, nāmaṃ sammutiyā ahu.
segments.thag7.5:2.1: “Na mayhaṃ kappate ajja, sare hatthehi bhañjituṃ;
segments.thag7.5:4.1: “Yeneva maggena gato vipassī, yeneva maggena sikhī ca vessabhū;
segments.thag7.5:4.3: Kakusandhakoṇāgamano ca kassapo, tenañjasena agamāsi gotamo.
segments.thag7.5:7.1: “Yasmiṃ nivattate [yasmiṃ na nibbattate (ka.)] dukkhaṃ, saṃsārasmiṃ anantakaṃ;
segments.thag7.5:7.3: Bhedā imassa kāyassa, jīvitassa ca saṅkhayā;
segments.thag7.5:8.3: Bhaddo thero ca sopāko, sarabhaṅgo mahāisi;
